CustomField.description: Staging mirror routed to GiftTransaction.FQS_Skip_Naming__c on commit. When TRUE, the FQS Auto Name Gift Transaction flow skips the resulting GT record and leaves Name as-is. Paired with FQS_GC_Skip_Naming__c on the commitment side — Salesforce enforces one GiftEntry source field to one destination field per FieldMappingConfig. Use for imports or integration writes that carry an authoritative external Name.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check to prevent the FQS auto-naming flow from overwriting the Name on the resulting Gift Transaction.
CustomField.label: Skip FQS Auto Naming (GT)
